meta.title: 咖啡拉花技巧｜3个动作细节，让你稳定出图
meta.topic: 咖啡拉花 · 稳定出图的动作细节

scenes.context: 握奶缸的方法直接影响拉花稳定性，核心是掌心留出空间。
sentences: 要拉花的时候，握奶缸的方法是非常重要的。
When pouring latte art, how you grip the pitcher really matters.
grip（握法）
用两三个手指握在下方，另两个手指轻轻放在两侧。
Hold it with two or three fingers at the bottom, and rest the other two lightly on the sides.
rest ... lightly（轻轻搭放）
放的时候这个是不用力的，只是轻轻的握它。
When you place them, they don't press at all — just a gentle hold.
press（用力按压）
paraphrase: Your grip on the pitcher is key to steady pouring.
Hold it loosely, without any force.
scenes.speak: When pouring latte art, how you grip the pitcher really matters. Hold it with two or three fingers at the bottom, and rest the other two lightly on the sides. When you place them, they don't press at all — just a gentle hold.

scenes.title_en: Sway with the Forearm, Not the Wrist
scenes.context: 拉花摆动靠小臂发力，手腕摆动会让水流不稳定。
sentences: 我们用的是这个小臂，这个手腕是不动的。
We use the forearm — the wrist stays still.
forearm（小臂）
手背在上面，胳膊比手腕高。
The back of the hand faces up, with the arm held higher than the wrist.
higher than（高于）
从我身体是前后摆动，不是左右摆动。
Sway forward and back along your body, not side to side.
side to side（左右）
paraphrase: Keep your wrist locked and let the forearm do the work.
Rock the pitcher front and back, following your body line.
scenes.speak: We use the forearm — the wrist stays still. The back of the hand faces up, with the arm held higher than the wrist. Sway forward and back along your body, not side to side.

scenes.context: 需要大量牛奶注入时，靠身体倾斜带动整只手臂，而不是手腕发力。
sentences: 注入的时候不能是手腕这么去倒。
When pouring in, you can't just pour with your wrist.
pour in（注入）
我手腕不动，哪里动呢？身体在倾斜。
If my wrist doesn't move, what does? My body tilts.
tilt（倾斜）
用手腕去倒，流量是往垂直下去的。
Pouring with the wrist sends the flow straight down.
vertical（垂直的）
paraphrase: Lean your whole body into the pour instead of flicking the wrist.
A wrist pour drives the milk straight down.
scenes.speak: When pouring in, you can't just pour with your wrist. If my wrist doesn't move, what does? My body tilts. Pouring with the wrist sends the flow straight down.

scenes.title_en: Holding the Cup and Keeping Perpendicular
scenes.context: 端杯用手指拖着杯底，手腕与奶缸保持垂直，做图案时手腕不弯曲。
sentences: 可以这么拿，不要手心放在杯底。
You can hold it this way — don't cup the palm around the bottom.
cup the palm（手掌托住）
手指不能伸进杯子里。
Never put your fingers inside the cup.
inside（在里面）
这个手腕和奶缸的这个部分是垂直的。
This wrist and the pitcher stay perpendicular.
perpendicular（垂直的）
paraphrase: Support the cup from below with your fingertips.
Keep your wrist straight — no bending while you pour.
scenes.speak: You can hold it this way — don't cup the palm around the bottom. Never put your fingers inside the cup. This wrist and the pitcher stay perpendicular.

practice: Keep your palm open — never press it against the pitcher.
The forearm drives the sway, not the wrist.
大流量注入时身体怎么配合？
Tilt your body so the arm tilts with the pour.
端杯时手指不能伸进哪里？
Never let your fingers go inside the cup.
pitfalls: 握死奶缸会让手腕僵硬，摆动不灵活。
手腕摆动水流忽大忽小，图案会歪。
手腕倒奶流量垂直向下，奶泡铺不开。
手指入杯会改变杯身重心，图案易抖。
footer_notes: ASR 校正：转录中「油质/流质」统一为牛奶流动性语境；时间轴以 Whisper 分段为准。
